metadata.question: Did the nighttime brightness at Biju Patnaik Airport decrease more than the brightness at Saheed Nagar (20.290813, 85.848691) between April 30, 2019 and May 5, 2019?

data.raw_code: This question is about comparing nighttime brightness changes between two locations (Biju Patnaik Airport and Saheed Nagar) over a specific time period (April 30, 2019 to May 5, 2019). For nighttime brightness, I should use the VIIRS Nighttime Day/Night Band data from the NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1 collection. This provides monthly composites of nighttime lights. Strategy: 1. Get coordinates for both locations - Biju Patnaik Airport: I'll use approximate coordinates (20.2543, 85.8176) - Saheed Nagar: given as (20.290813, 85.848691) 2. Time period: April 30, 2019 to May 5, 2019 (but VIIRS is monthly, so I'll use April 2019 and May 2019 monthly composites) 3. Calculate brightness change at each location 4. Compare which decreased more I need to: - Check if collections have data - Extract brightness values using points - Calculate percentage change - Compare which decreased more ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions airport_point = ee.Geometry.Point([85.8176, 20.2543]) # Biju Patnaik Airport saheed_point = ee.Geometry.Point([85.848691, 20.290813]) # Saheed Nagar # Use monthly VIIRS data for April and May 2019 start_date_apr = '2019-04-01' end_date_apr = '2019-04-30' start_date_may = '2019-05-01' end_date_may = '2019-05-31' # 2. Data Acquisition viirs_apr = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1') \ .filterDate(start_date_apr, end_date_apr) viirs_may = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1') \ .filterDate(start_date_may, end_date_may) # Check if collections have data if viirs_apr.size().getInfo() == 0 or viirs_may.size().getInfo() == 0: print("April images: " + str(viirs_apr.size().getInfo())) print("May images: " + str(viirs_may.size().getInfo())) print("C1") else: # Get mean images for each month apr_img = viirs_apr.mean() may_img = viirs_may.mean() # Extract brightness values for both locations airport_apr = apr_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=airport_point, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('avg_rad').getInfo() airport_may = may_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=airport_point, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('avg_rad').getInfo() saheed_apr = apr_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=saheed_point, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('avg_rad').getInfo() saheed_may = may_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=saheed_point, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('avg_rad').getInfo() # Check for valid data if None in [airport_apr, airport_may, saheed_apr, saheed_may]: print("Airport Apr: " + str(airport_apr)) print("Airport May: " + str(airport_may)) print("Saheed Apr: " + str(saheed_apr)) print("Saheed May: " + str(saheed_may)) print("C3") else: # Calculate percentage changes airport_change = ((airport_may - airport_apr) / airport_apr) * 100 saheed_change = ((saheed_may - saheed_apr) / saheed_apr) * 100 print(f"Airport: {airport_apr:.2f} -> {airport_may:.2f} ({airport_change:.1f}%)") print(f"Saheed: {saheed_apr:.2f} -> {saheed_may:.2f} ({saheed_change:.1f}%)") # Check if airport decreased more than saheed # Both changes are negative for decrease, so we compare the magnitude if airport_change < saheed_change: # More negative = greater decrease print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
airport_point = ee.Geometry.Point([85.8176, 20.2543])  # Biju Patnaik Airport
saheed_point = ee.Geometry.Point([85.848691, 20.290813])  # Saheed Nagar

# Use monthly VIIRS data for April and May 2019
start_date_apr = '2019-04-01'
end_date_apr = '2019-04-30'
start_date_may = '2019-05-01'
end_date_may = '2019-05-31'

# 2. Data Acquisition
viirs_apr = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1') \
    .filterDate(start_date_apr, end_date_apr)
viirs_may = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1') \
    .filterDate(start_date_may, end_date_may)

# Check if collections have data
if viirs_apr.size().getInfo() == 0 or viirs_may.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("April images: " + str(viirs_apr.size().getInfo()))
    print("May images: " + str(viirs_may.size().getInfo()))
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # Get mean images for each month
    apr_img = viirs_apr.mean()
    may_img = viirs_may.mean()
    
    # Extract brightness values for both locations
    airport_apr = apr_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=airport_point,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    
    airport_may = may_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=airport_point,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    
    saheed_apr = apr_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=saheed_point,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    
    saheed_may = may_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
        geometry=saheed_point,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('avg_rad').getInfo()
    
    # Check for valid data
    if None in [airport_apr, airport_may, saheed_apr, saheed_may]:
        print("Airport Apr: " + str(airport_apr))
        print("Airport May: " + str(airport_may))
        print("Saheed Apr: " + str(saheed_apr))
        print("Saheed May: " + str(saheed_may))
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        # Calculate percentage changes
        airport_change = ((airport_may - airport_apr) / airport_apr) * 100
        saheed_change = ((saheed_may - saheed_apr) / saheed_apr) * 100
        
        print(f"Airport: {airport_apr:.2f} -> {airport_may:.2f} ({airport_change:.1f}%)")
        print(f"Saheed: {saheed_apr:.2f} -> {saheed_may:.2f} ({saheed_change:.1f}%)")
        
        # Check if airport decreased more than saheed
        # Both changes are negative for decrease, so we compare the magnitude
        if airport_change < saheed_change:  # More negative = greater decrease
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
